name: security-recipes.ai
tagline: Turn CVE intelligence into verified, evidence-backed remediation teams can trust.
description: Open, self-hostable knowledge layer linking source-backed CVE research to bounded remediation recipes, required evidence, rollback guidance, and human-reviewed outcomes—built for security leaders who need traceable action, not another alert stream.

name: OSS Dependency Explorer
tagline: Map multi-ecosystem dependencies and surface supply-chain risk before production.
description: Supply-chain visibility for security and engineering leaders: maps package dependencies across eight ecosystems and combines vulnerability, repository health, license, and SBOM analysis so risk is triaged before it ships.

name: Shiba Studio
tagline: Local-first studio to build, govern, and audit production-ready AI agents.
description: Unifies agent orchestration, workspace-aware coding, browser control, scheduling, integrations, memory, and auditable local workflows—so organizations automate with AI without surrendering data control or auditability.

name: Stevo.AI
tagline: Governed AI operations that critique, revise, and ship only under CI controls.
description: Live proof of agentic content operations with control at every step: an AI advisor reframes copy under code-enforced factual guards, opens a pull request, passes CI, merges, and deploys—evidence for leaders evaluating governed AI enablement.

name: Pro Response
tagline: Raise enterprise message quality with AI inside Slack and existing channels.
description: Multi-provider writing assistant that rewrites, translates, summarizes, and reformats messages via Slack, HTTP API, CLI, or Python—clearer communication without pulling teams out of the tools they already use.

name: Spare Cycles
tagline: Open-source distributed inference research across volunteer nodes.
description: MIT-licensed research platform pooling volunteer Claude, GPT, Grok, or Ollama capacity behind an OpenAI-compatible API—demonstrating distributed orchestration and multi-provider routing.

name: Tiny Book Buddies AI
tagline: Idea to illustrated, narrated children's storybook—entirely in the browser.
description: Browser-based story studio that writes, illustrates, narrates, and exports children's books with user-selected AI providers—a complete consumer AI workflow delivered without a backend.

name: mouseclicker.app
tagline: Portable Windows auto-clicker with record/replay and optional AI patterns.
description: Desktop automation utility with humanized cursor movement, global hotkeys, system-wide record/replay, and optional cloud or local AI pattern generation—packaged as a portable Windows utility with no installer.

name: DOGE Commerce Kit
tagline: Non-custodial toolkit for accepting Dogecoin in person or online.
description: Non-custodial commerce toolkit with browser wallet utilities, point-of-sale checkout, payment QR codes, on-chain verification, a local order ledger, and embeddable components for independent sellers.

name: Arrowhead Paesano
tagline: Chiefs fan site with an automated weekly game-preview desk.
description: Static fan site for the Arrowhead Paesano YouTube channel: privacy-friendly playback from a checked-in snapshot, plus a sourced weekly preview with matchups, projections, and a ready-to-shoot run-of-show.

name: Desert Wander Supply Co.
tagline: Southwest outdoor gear storefront for desert travel and EDC.
description: Hosted storefront for desert exploration gear spanning apparel, outdoor accessories, and pet gear, with a merchandised catalog, checkout, and customer email capture.

name: DOGE MINER
tagline: Cross-platform Scrypt pool miner with live dashboard and hardware telemetry.
description: Full-stack Dogecoin pool miner for CPU and OpenCL GPUs, with live pool responses, share statistics, hardware telemetry, and on-chain wallet data in a transparent, registration-free product.
